== Title ==
<span lang="ja">スウィラ・コアリー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらか選ぶこと。1：盗賊でないキャラクターに配備して、盗賊技能を持たせる。自分の支配フェイズに同じ位置カード上のアイテムを1つ目標として選ぶ。運命数を引く。運命数＜目標の運命数なら、目標を“盗む”。2：武器に配備して、盗まれるのを防ぐ。このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">銀河中にいる小悪党たちは、時として新参者に悪事のコツを教えて小金を稼ぐ。帝国の圧政が強まるにつれ、盗賊の数も増えていった。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Swilla Corey]].

'''Lore''' — Petty criminals throughout the galaxy sometimes earn extra money by teaching newcomers the tricks of crime. As Imperial oppression tightens, the number of thieves also grows.

'''Game text''' — Choose one. 1: Deploy on a non-thief character to give thief skill. During your control phase, target one item on the same location card. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than the target's destiny, steal the target. 2: Deploy on a weapon to prevent it from being stolen. This Effect is not affected by Alter.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Functions are numbered 1/2 instead of OR. Game text uses アイテム and 位置カード where English says device and same site. Alter is 「意識操作」.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-swillacorey-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Swilla Corey]].</ref>
